description: This file is a PHP class defining an admin dashboard controller for managing orders in OpenCart. It includes methods for displaying order statistics, saving configurations, and rendering order info views.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Controller class for managing the dashboard order widget in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language, sets the page title, prepares breadcrumbs, and renders the order form view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the dashboard order settings, validating permissions, and returning a JSON response.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Generates and returns the dashboard data, including total orders, percentage change, and total sales, and renders the dashboard view.
